description: Usability arithmetic with formulas shown. mode sus: score System Usability Scale responses (rows of ten 1-5 answers) with grade, percentile and 95% interval. mode discovery: participants needed to find a share of problems (Nielsen and Landauer). mode ab: sample size per variant for a conversion test (baseline, lift in percent, optional dailyVisitors). mode survey: responses needed for a margin of error.

dailyVisitors.description: ab: traffic per day, to estimate how long to run

lift.description: ab: smallest relative lift to detect, percent

p.description: discovery: chance a participant hits a problem, default 0.31

population.description: survey: total population, for the finite-population correction

target.description: discovery: share of problems to find, default 0.85

name: usability_stats
title: Usability numbers
